newsitem.title: CHINA: China province in $482 mln power plant expansion.
newsitem.headline: China province in $482 mln power plant expansion.

text.p: A power plant in China's southern province of Guangdong has started a 4.0 billion yuan expansion, the Xinhua news agency said on Monday.
The expansion of the plant in the provincial capital, Guangzhou, would double the plant's generating capacity to 2,400 megawatts, Xinhua said.
To be completed in 1999, the new facilities at the Guangzhou Water Pumping and Energy Storage Station would use stored water to generate extra power in peak periods, the agency said.
The first phase, which went into operation three years ago, had recently passed state inspections, Xinhua said but gave no further details.
